title: A3 — Frontend / Storefront Engineering Prompt
description: Create the specialized A3 Frontend / Storefront Engineering prompt inheriting the canonical Phase B Base Agent Contract. Define scoped storefront implementation authority for apps/storefront, RTL/Persian-first UX, responsive/accessibility behavior, API consumption, server-authoritative trust boundaries, state/error/recovery UX and cross-agent coordination without granting product, backend, review, verification, security or human-gate authority.

why_low: This task is documentation-only and changes only the A3 prompt, its Task Contract and generated Task Catalog.
No runtime storefront code is changed by this registration task.
No backend, database, auth, payment, pricing, inventory, CI or protection behavior is mutated.
Future A3 implementation tasks remain independently risk-classified by actual changed paths and task rules.
risk_rationale.escalation_condition: If deterministic classification or actual changed paths raise effective risk above LOW, stop and follow the higher-risk policy; downgrade is prohibited.

acceptance_criteria.description: A3 contains Role Definition, Authority Boundaries, Read Scope, Write Scope, Forbidden Actions, Output Format and Failure Behavior.
A3 defines scoped storefront authority centered on apps/storefront and explicitly excludes business-rule, backend, database and admin ownership by default.
A3 covers RTL/Persian-first UX, responsive behavior, accessibility, loading/error/empty/recovery states and safe API consumption.
A3 preserves server authority for price, inventory, wholesale, orders, payments, permissions and other trust-sensitive state.
A3 output format preserves CLAIMED_CANONICAL_PASS = NO and rejects self-review/self-verification.
Deterministic classification remains LOW with Human Gate NOT REQUIRED; any higher result blocks LOW execution.
The PR changes exactly the three authorized paths and no forbidden path.
Exact-head checks, protected Merge Policy transport, exact-SHA post-merge verification and terminal Lock release complete before A3 is called canonical.
